own_solution.law: The magnetic-sublevel shifts are g m mu_B B, with mu_B = e hbar/(2 me). For the six allowed electric-dipole transitions, the extreme transition shifts are ±(gu + gl)mu_B B/2. Thus their energy separation is (gu + gl)mu_B B, and their first-order wavelength separation is lambda^2 times this energy separation divided by hc.
assumptions: The explicitly stated linear Zeeman model applies.
All six allowed components are observed.
The stated first-order wavelength approximation applies.
Energy in joules is converted to electronvolts using the specified exact elementary charge before using hc in eV nm; the resulting wavelength separation is converted to pm.
